proposal.snippet:
constructionVariants: [
  {
    id: "unreal-present-condition-wenn",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise targeting an unreal present condition with a full wenn-clause in Konjunktiv II. " +
      "The wenn-clause and main clause must both appear, e.g. 'Wenn ich Zeit hätte, würde ich kommen.' " +
      "Use either synthetic forms or würde + infinitive in the main clause.",
    share: 3,
  },
  {
    id: "verb-first-conditional",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise targeting a verb-first (inverted) conditional without wenn in Konjunktiv II. " +
      "The finite verb must open the sentence, e.g. 'Hätte ich Zeit, würde ich sofort kommen.' " +
      "Do not include a wenn-clause.",
    share: 2,
  },
  {
    id: "unreal-wish-exclamative",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise targeting an unreal wish or exclamative in Konjunktiv II. " +
      "Use a wenn-clause with a modal particle (doch, nur, bloß) and no main clause, " +
      "e.g. 'Wenn ich das doch wüsste!' or 'Wenn er nur käme!'",
    share: 2,
  },
  {
    id: "als-ob-unreal-comparison",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise targeting an unreal comparison with als ob + Konjunktiv II. " +
      "The subordinate clause must follow als ob with the finite verb in final position, " +
      "e.g. 'Er tut so, als ob er nichts wüsste.'",
    share: 2,
  },
  {
    id: "synthetic-konjunktiv-ii-forms",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise that foregrounds a synthetic Konjunktiv II form (käme, wüsste, ginge, bliebe, nähme, etc.) " +
      "rather than a würde + infinitive periphrasis. The synthetic form must appear in the gapped or targeted position, " +
      "e.g. 'Wenn er früher ___ (kommen), könnten wir reden.' → käme.",
    share: 2,
  },
  {
    id: "wuerde-infinitive-periphrasis",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise where the main clause uses würde + infinitive periphrasis in Konjunktiv II. " +
      "The würde-form must be the targeted item, e.g. 'Wenn ich mehr Geld hätte, ___ ich eine Reise machen.' → würde.",
    share: 1,
  },
  {
    id: "unreal-past-condition",
    directive:
      "Write an exercise targeting an unreal past condition in Konjunktiv II (Konjunktiv II Vergangenheit). " +
      "Both clauses must use hätte/wäre + Partizip II, e.g. 'Hätte ich das gewusst, wäre ich zu Hause geblieben.'",
    share: 1,
  },
],
proposal.notes: Two variants had zero realized exercises (unreal-wish-exclamative, synthetic-konjunktiv-ii-forms) and one more was near zero (unreal-past-condition); all are now explicit variants with share ≥ 1 so the generator is forced to target them. The prototypical wenn-clause construction keeps a plurality share of 3 against six other variants totalling 11, giving it ~23 % of the pool rather than the ~46 % it currently dominates.
